subject: Clarify per-call credits, bulk tiering, and POC discount for rerank/classifier
messages:
From: Emma K <emma@zephyra.io>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: carlos.vega@zephyra.io, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on rerank billing model and credits for POC

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Zephyr's search team loved the latency profile on the rerank endpoint. Before we move to a short POC, can you confirm how we would be billed for the rerank/classifier path? A couple of specifics: 

- Do you bill "per scoring call" (i.e., per request regardless of item count) or "per item scored" (per candidate scored inside a request)?
- Is there a separate cost for generating embeddings vs. the reranker score?
- For a 6-week POC (expected ~200k candidate scores total, spikes to 30k/day), what flexibility do you offer for credits or reduced fees?

I've attached a one-pager on the MVP profile. Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Emma
Product Lead, Zephyr Analytics
--
Zephyr_MVP_requirements.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma K <emma@zephyra.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Question on rerank billing model and credits for POC

Hi Emma — great to hear the demo resonated. Short answers up front, then details below: 

- Billing: we charge per "score unit". A score unit is billed per candidate scored by the reranker/classifier. There is also a small, separate token-based charge if you call a generative model as part of preprocessing.
- Embeddings: embeddings are metered separately (per-embedding unit) unless you use our bundled "relevance" endpoints where we collapse embedding + scoring into a single bundled rate.
- POC credits: we can offer a POC credit up to 75% off the baseline rate for the first 250k score units, with a capped trial credit (credit applied to hosted API usage only).

I'll attach our latest ratecard and a short worked example for your volumes. If that looks good we can put together a mutual action plan and a short canary rollout for the 6-week POC. 

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Subject: Fwd: RE: Question on rerank billing model and credits for POC

Team — forwarding Zephyr's ask. Quick notes: 

- They expect ~200k score units for a 6-week POC, peak 30k/day.
- They want clarity on per-call vs per-item. I told them we bill per scored item but also have commit tiers that reduce rate units once they hit monthly thresholds.
- Can we offer 75% credit up to 250k score units for POC (hosted API only)? That's generous but keeps them moving. 
- If they convert to a contract (Dedicated or Reserved), propose a 20–30% volume discount on baseline and apply committed burst credits for the first 90 days.

Aditya — any objections on the POC credit? Marissa — can you prepare a short worked example (spreadsheet) showing the math for 200k and 500k monthly scoring volumes and a suggested canary config.

Thanks,
Laura

Subject: Re: RE: Question on rerank billing model and credits for POC

Laura — thanks, that is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

1) The 200k is conservative — if initial results look good we may double. Can you confirm how quickly the price steps down after crossing volume tiers (e.g., at 500k/mo)?
2) For the POC credit: we prefer a simple credit applied as a dollar offset (not token credits). Can you confirm that the credit is applied automatically to the hosted account usage and that it will be visible on the invoice?
3) If we move to a 3‑month pilot with an option to convert to reserved capacity, what would the mid-term discount look like?

Also — we asked our procurement team to run a standard security questionnaire; we may need a SOC 2 letter and a few artifacts. Happy to have your CS/security team coordinate.

Thanks,
Carlos
VP Engineering, Zephyr Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vephyra.io>, Emma K <emma@zephyra.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Question on rerank billing model and credits for POC

Carlos / Emma — good questions. Final proposal so we can lock next steps: 

1) Billing model: per scored candidate = $0.0025 / score unit (baseline hosted rate). Embeddings (if used) billed at $0.0008 per embedding unit unless you use bundled relevance endpoint (see attached spreadsheet for example math). Volume tiers: 0–499k = baseline, 500k–1.5M = 20% off baseline, >1.5M = 35% off baseline (applies to scored candidates).

2) POC credit: Redwood will issue a dollar credit equal to 75% of baseline billed cost for up to 250k score units during the POC period. Credit applies to the hosted API invoice automatically; we'll surface it as a line item on the bill. No DocuSign required for the credit itself, but we'll document the MOU in HubSpot.

3) Pilot-to-contract path: If you convert to a 3-month reserved commit within 60 days of the POC, we will offer a 25% committed discount on the baseline scoring rate and 90 days of committed burst protection (guaranteed capacity + capped overage pricing).

4) Security artifacts: our CS team will send SOC 2 attestation and a short evidence package (log samples, retention policy). I've looped in aditya for the technical scope and Marissa for billing examples.

Next steps: 
- Emma: confirm POC dates and expected daily volume range.
- Carlos: share procurement contact for SOC 2 artifacts.
- Laura: I'll create the HubSpot MOU and attach the ratecard + worked examples, then send DocuSign for the pilot conversion term sheet after POC acceptance.

If that matches what you need, I'll schedule a short handoff call with CS/security this week.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
